title: ShoppingListsView: core list structure
description: Add `CookbookApp/ShoppingLists/ShoppingListsView.swift` with the core list-of-lists view: `NavigationStack` with navigation title "Shopping Lists", a `List` of `ShoppingListCardView` rows driven by `ShoppingListFiles.discover` sorted reverse-chronologically, `NavigationLink` / `.navigationDestination` wiring to `ShoppingListDetailView`, and the empty state (SF Symbol `cart`, "No shopping lists yet.", "Tap + to create your first shopping list."). No top-trailing toolbar icons (no folder, no ellipsis menu). FAB and search are added in the next bead.
acceptance_criteria: `.md` files in the folder render as `ShoppingListCardView` rows sorted reverse-chronologically
Tapping a row pushes `ShoppingListDetailView` via navigationDestination
Empty state renders with `cart` icon, correct title, and subtitle when no `.md` files exist
No folder icon or ellipsis toolbar item in the top-trailing area (v1 omits both)

handoff_summary.completed: ShoppingListsView.swift created with: NavigationStack + ".navigationTitle("Shopping Lists")", async loadEntries task that calls ShoppingListFiles.discover (already reverse-sorted by mtime) and reads ShoppingList.items for counts, List of Button-wrapped ShoppingListCardView rows (Button avoids duplicate disclosure chevron since ShoppingListCardView renders its own chevron.right), navigationDestination(item:) wired to ShoppingListDetailView, empty state using existing EmptyStateView with cart/title/subtitle, no toolbar items. ShoppingListDetailView.swift stub created. ShoppingListsTab.swift updated to read folderURL from RecipesFolderStore environment and pass to ShoppingListsView. xcodegen regenerated and xcodebuild exit:0.
handoff_summary.remaining: ShoppingListDetailView stub must be replaced by the ShoppingListDetailView bead. FAB and .searchable are added in the next bead per spec.
handoff_summary.risks: ShoppingListDetailView.swift is a stub — it must not ship as-is. The downstream detail-view bead should replace or overwrite it entirely. File-level conflict risk is low since ShoppingListDetailView.swift is a known placeholder.
handoff_summary.next_action: The ShoppingListDetailView bead should overwrite the stub ShoppingListDetailView.swift with a full implementation. The FAB+search bead should add .searchable and the floating action button to ShoppingListsView.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: ShoppingListDetailView.swift was created as a stub by this bead. The downstream detail-view developer bead must own that file entirely — no merge conflict expected if that bead simply overwrites it. ShoppingListsTab.swift was modified; any bead that also touches the tab should be aware it now delegates to ShoppingListsView(folderURL:).
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used Button + @State selectedURL + navigationDestination(item:) instead of NavigationLink(value:) to avoid a double disclosure-chevron: ShoppingListCardView already renders its own chevron.right, and NavigationLink inside List adds a system chevron on top. The private ShoppingListEntry model is local to the file; it does not need to be public since it is only used for view rendering. loadEntries opens the folder security scope after discover (which opens/closes it internally) — nested scope calls are ref-counted and safe per iOS documentation.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests written in this bead — test execution is exclusively the tester agent's responsibility. Visual correctness (card layout, empty-state icon, relative-date text) cannot be unit-tested per ui-guidelines.md and must be verified manually.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: ShoppingListDetailView.swift is a placeholder stub. The empty-state empty-state subtitle says 'Tap + to create your first shopping list.' even though the FAB is not yet wired (added in the next bead) — this matches the spec's stated phasing. The nil guard before showing the list produces a brief Color.clear flash on first load; this matches the RecipesListView pattern in the project.
